about:
I am an engineer from Malaysia who is currently changing career to the Software Developing Industry


 I love to use technologies and tools to improve day-to-day life by developing automation solutions for repetitive and redundant tasks. I am passionate about continuous improvement through identifying gaps in current practices and designing solutions that can maximize the benefit to cost ratio. 

 I enjoy planning and follow through the execution. I have planned for small scale skiing trips to Japan, as well as large scale industry turnaround project involving hundreds of people and multi-millions of values at stake. 

 I am excited about going deep by learning and analyzing to solve a complex challenge, while also going wide to understand how the solution can be applied to a wider range of scenarios. I am also thrilled at connecting the dots when solving problems, maximizing the benefits of the solutions while minimizing the side effects.
